applies_to: future diagnostic confirmation and replication campaigns only
primary_endpoint_unchanged: required supported mechanism identified and no material unsupported or contradicted assertion
study_label_rule: Both isolated Luna passes are retained. Agreement supplies the operational semantic label. A primary or guardrail disagreement is unresolved unless an independently checkable fact or frozen rule settles it; no additional Luna vote is permitted.

annotation_error_sensitivity.interpretation: This is a predeclared robustness analysis under finite qualification uncertainty, not proof that the Wilson upper bounds are hard population error limits.
annotation_error_sensitivity.confidence_method: pass-specific Wilson score 95 percent intervals; use the larger pass-specific upper bound and round upward to four decimals

supported_diagnostic_success.method_specific_count_rule: At each registered look, P worst case changes up to ceil(0.3904 * judged P successes) P successes to failures; R best case changes up to ceil(0.1844 * judged R failures) R failures to successes. Use the adversarial paired arrangement that minimizes the P-minus-R lower bound.

material_error.method_specific_count_rule: At each registered look, P worst case changes up to ceil(0.3904 * judged P non-errors) to errors; R best case changes up to ceil(0.1844 * judged R errors) to non-errors. Use the adversarial paired arrangement that maximizes the P-minus-R upper bound.

useful_required_unit_coverage.source: zero observed required-unit errors among 32 fresh units; larger pass-specific Wilson upper bound rounded upward
useful_required_unit_coverage.rule: For each cluster and method, retain integer covered and total required-unit counts. Decrease P covered units and increase R covered units by ceil(0.1072 * that answer's required-unit total), within [0,total], before the paired coverage bound.

correct_ambiguous_case_handling.source: zero observed composite errors among 20 fresh composite cases; larger pass-specific Wilson upper bound rounded upward
correct_ambiguous_case_handling.rule: For ambiguous clusters, apply the same adversarial paired binary transformation as the primary endpoint, using 0.1612 for both P observed-correct to incorrect and R observed-incorrect to correct.

annotation_error_sensitivity.unresolved_rule: Any unresolved primary or guardrail field prevents success and remains in adversarial sensitivity; it is never removed from a denominator.
annotation_error_sensitivity.success_rule: Nominal corrected sequential bounds, every nominal guardrail, and all annotation-sensitivity bounds must pass at the same registered look. Otherwise the result is label-sensitive and not confirmatory success.
